summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal 8.0.11 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, unpacks it, marks the binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` on a shipped sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line blob carrying obfuscator.io fingerprints (hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled string/number array, a `WV8StW` rotator, and codepoint reconstruction) with no readable strings. The package's advertised purpose is a Babel preset (`lib/index.js` is a small 18-line preset function), which has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an opaque local payload. Using Bun to run the payload bypasses Node-based install-time inspection, and the obfuscation prevents static introspection of what the payload does once executed. The install-time trigger fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
